headline: Solar Panel Costs Drop 98% in Two Decades
meta_description: Solar panel costs have fallen dramatically from $6 per watt in 2000 to just 12 cents today, making renewable energy more accessible than ever.
summary_short: Solar panel costs have crashed from $6 per watt in 2000 to just 12 cents today—a stunning 98% decline that's transforming clean energy accessibility.
body:
Solar panel costs have plummeted from $6 per watt in 2000 to just 12 cents today, marking one of the most dramatic price collapses in energy technology history.

This staggering 98% reduction over two decades reflects rapid advances in manufacturing, economies of scale, and global competition. What once required significant investment to install is now within reach for far more households and businesses, fundamentally changing the economics of renewable energy adoption.

The shift signals a turning point in how communities worldwide can power themselves. As affordability barriers crumble, solar energy transitions from a luxury investment to a practical choice for families and organizations seeking sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels.
